mainEntity.name: Who is Jason Obawemimo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jason Obawemimo is the founder of Obavia, sales software in development for agency owners at $100K to $1M a month, and the co-owner and operator of Triple J Auto Investment in Houston. He builds the systems underneath a business, then runs them.

mainEntity.name: What does Jason Obawemimo build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jason Obawemimo builds the systems underneath a business, then runs them: Obavia's sales operating software (in development), the Handle a Sale desk Triple J closes sales on, workflow systems, CRM and database handoffs, SOPs, reporting structures, and practical AI-assisted operations using tools such as Claude, Codex, Model Context Protocol, Supabase, PostgreSQL, and Vercel.

mainEntity.name: What is Obavia?

acceptedAnswer.text: Obavia (https://obavia.co) is sales operating software, in development, founded by Jason Obawemimo, for agency owners generating $100,000 to $1,000,000 a month and their own setters and closers. It works inside the agency's own funnel, SOPs and vocabulary, and follows a sale in six stages: Capture (the inquiry becomes a lead), Connect (one owner, the buyer's exact words), Book (a call with a clear purpose), Discover (fit, from what actually happened), Agree (the buyer's words reach the closer), and Collect (cash, counted when verified). Tagline: "Hear what clients really mean. Carry it from the first call to collected cash."

mainEntity.name: Who is Obavia for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Obavia is for agency owners generating $100,000 to $1,000,000 a month, and for their own setters and closers. Owners see progress ranked on collected cash, not calls.

mainEntity.name: Is Obavia available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not yet. Obavia is in development and not yet live. It has a free waitlist at https://obavia.co; joining the waitlist does not create an account or grant product access.

mainEntity.name: What does Obavia cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prelaunch pricing: Core is planned at $3,000 a month (up to 10 active sellers, 5,000 pooled meeting minutes). Scale ($6,000 a month) and Enterprise (custom) are proposed. Implementation is a one-time $5,000. Only Core's price is planned; the rest is proposed.

mainEntity.name: What will Obavia never claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it is in development, Obavia does not claim to be live, to have customers, or to produce results, and it states no conversion rate, percentage, or outcome as fact. Zoom, Calendly, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Slack, Zapier, Google Calendar and Cal.com are planned connection targets, not active integrations. People and figures in Obavia's demos and ads are fictional. Jason Obawemimo set that boundary himself.

mainEntity.name: What is Triple J's Handle a Sale desk?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is the sale desk Jason Obawemimo built and Triple J Auto Investment closes sales on. It asks one plain question at a time (how the buyer is paying, who files the registration), scans the buyer's license once so every form fills itself, does the registration math, and routes the deal to the right documents with nothing missing and nothing extra. It works in English or Spanish, carries Jason's signature with the customer signing on their phone or in person, and saves every sale on file. A demo film is at https://jasonobawemimo.com/assets/film/triple-j-sale-desk.mp4.
